votes.quote: The code is split into separate units: the rate limiter is in `src/rateLimiter.ts` with an injected clock (`constructor(limit: number, now: () => number, windowMs = 1000)`). Retry and backoff live in `src/dispatcher.ts`, which takes an injected `send`. Forwarding is the `fetch`-based `send` in `main.ts`, and HTTP routing is in `relay.ts`. Tests control time with `mock.timers.enable({ apis: ["setTimeout"] })` and `now: () => t`, and use a local destination server (`createServer` + `listen`). State is kept per tenant: `state.set(id, { limiter: new SlidingWindowLimiter(config.requestsPerSecond, now), dispatcher: new TenantDispatcher(id, config, ...) })`.
